Bakerloo.reason: Bakerloo Line: Severe delays while we fix a signal failure at Paddington and due to strike action. London Overground are operating a more frequent service between Queen's Park and Harrow & Wealdstone.

Central.reason: Central Line: No service between White City and Liverpool Street and MINOR DELAYS on the rest of the line due to strike action. Service is operating between White City and Ealing Broadway / West Ruislip and between Liverpool Street and Epping / Woodford via Hainault every 10 minutes.

Circle.reason: Circle Line: No service on the entire line due to strike action.

District.reason: District Line: Severe delays on the entire line due to strike action. Services are operating approximately every 10 minutes.

Hammersmith & City.reason: Hammersmith and City Line: Severe delays due to strike action. Services are operating approximately every 30 minutes.

Metropolitan.reason: Metropolitan Line: No service between Baker Street and Aldgate due to strike action. MINOR DELAYS on the rest of the line. Services are operating between Baker Street and Amersham / Chesham every 30 minutes and between Baker Street and Watford / Uxbridge every 15 minutes.

Northern.reason: Northern Line: Minor delays between High Barnet and East Finchley and MINOR DELAYS between Edgware and Golders Green due to strike action.  SEVERE DELAYS on the rest of the line.

Piccadilly.reason: Piccadilly Line: No service between Arnos Grove and Heathrow Airport / Uxbridge and SEVERE DELAYS on the rest of the line due to strike action. Service is operating between Arnos Grove and Cockfosters every 15 minutes.

Victoria.reason: Victoria Line: Minor delays due to strike action.

Waterloo & City.reason: Waterloo and City Line: No service on the entire line due to strike action.
